from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-high-ws0/frozen/held-out-4/play/users/u064/system/state/workspace/programs/task-fc9280a8.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    """Fill each framed cutout with the matching colored shape from the right."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    left_w = 0
    while left_w < w and grid[0][left_w] != 0:
        left_w += 1
    frame = grid[0][0]
    output = [row[:left_w] for row in grid]

    separators = [r for r in range(h) if all(grid[r][c] == frame for c in range(left_w))]
    bands = [(a + 1, b) for a, b in zip(separators, separators[1:]) if b > a + 1]

    # Collect each colored object to the right of the frame as a normalized mask.
    seen = set()
    objects = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(left_w, w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                rr, cc = stack.pop()
                cells.append((rr, cc))
                for nr, nc in ((rr-1, cc), (rr+1, cc), (rr, cc-1), (rr, cc+1)):
                    if 0 <= nr < h and left_w <= nc < w and (nr, nc) not in seen and grid[nr][nc] == color:
                        seen.add((nr, nc))
                        stack.append((nr, nc))
            r0, r1 = min(x for x, y in cells), max(x for x, y in cells)
            c0, c1 = min(y for x, y in cells), max(y for x, y in cells)
            mask = frozenset((rr-r0, cc-c0) for rr, cc in cells)
            objects.append((color, r1-r0+1, c1-c0+1, mask))

    for start, end in bands:
        holes = [(r, c) for r in range(start, end) for c in range(1, left_w-1) if grid[r][c] == 0]
        if not holes:
            continue
        r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in holes), max(r for r, c in holes)
        c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in holes), max(c for r, c in holes)
        mask = frozenset((r-r0, c-c0) for r, c in holes)
        shape = next((obj for obj in objects if obj[1] == r1-r0+1 and obj[2] == c1-c0+1 and obj[3] == mask), None)
        if shape is not None:
            color = shape[0]
            for r, c in holes:
                output[r][c] = color
    return output
'''
p.write_text(code)
